set.body: Owner: surface-view-raster shared capability declaration and tests. SurfaceRasterizer.capabilities currently declares the caveat lighting is not applied by the reference raster backend, but its vertex path calls lightFactor and multiplies RGB by the declared ambient/diffuse world-normal Lambert factor. This contradicts current implementation and can mislead backend admission. Inspect live behavior, correct the capability/caveat documentation to the precise supported vertex-lighting semantics and limits, add a meaningful capability-plus-pixel regression and run raster JVM/JS tests. Found while fixing JavaFX lighting bd-01M1SV89BMW9EK71CT9Z4D399X; do not treat the JavaFX pixel oracle as raster backend validation.
set.title: Align reference raster lighting capability metadata with implemented shading
